title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 serisi tanıtıldı: Fiyatı ve özellikleri
summary: Samsung, MediaTek Dimensity 9500 işlemciye ve ince tasarıma sahip yeni amiral gemisi tabletleri Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra ve Tab S12+ modellerini duyurdu.
body:
Samsung'un duyurusuna göre, şirketin merakla beklenen yeni amiral gemisi tabletleri Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra ve Galaxy Tab S12+ resmi olarak görücüye çıktı. 30 Eylül'de yapılan duyuruyla birlikte 2026 amiral gemisi tablet serisi netleşirken, serideki iki model de ince tasarımları ve güçlü donanımlarıyla öne çıkıyor.

## Tasarım ve ekran özellikleri

Android Police'in aktardığına göre, Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra 5,1 milimetre kalınlığıyla şirketin en ince tableti olma unvanını taşırken, Galaxy Tab S12+ ise 5,3 milimetre kalınlığa sahip. Her iki cihaz da 1.600 nite varan parlaklık sunan Dynamic AMOLED 2X ekran teknolojisiyle geliyor. Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra 14,6 inç, Galaxy Tab S12+ ise 12,6 inç büyüklüğünde ekran alanına ev sahipliği yapıyor ve her iki ekran da 120Hz yenileme hızı sunuyor.

## Performans ve fiyatlandırma

MediaTek Dimensity 9500 işlemciden güç alan yeni tabletler, 4 kanallı uzamsal ses desteği ve soğutma için bir 3D Buhar Odası barındırıyor. SamMobile'ın aktardığına göre, Galaxy Tab S12+ modeli 1.199 dolardan başlayan fiyatlarla 7 Ekim'de raflardaki yerini alacak. S Pen kalemin kutudan çıktığı seride, Adobe Photoshop gibi üretkenlik uygulamaları da ön yüklü olarak sunuluyor.

**Neden önemli?** Samsung'un yeni tablet serisi, taşınabilir üretkenlik pazarında yüksek performans arayan kullanıcılar için güçlü ekran ve işlemci güncellemeleri getiriyor ancak yüksek fiyat etiketleriyle dikkat çekiyor.

source_texts.text:
Last updated: September 30th, 2026 at 14:00 UTC+02:00
The first new Plus model in two years.
Abhijeet Mishra / SamMobile
Samsung has just announced its latest premium tablets, and the company's unusual two-pronged strategy continues. As a result, the 2026 flagship tablet lineup includes the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and the Galaxy Tab S12+.
In other words, the Galaxy Tab S12+ is the closest you'll get to a direct Galaxy Tab S11 sequel in 2026. The last Plus model was the Galaxy Tab S10+ in 2024.
Here's everything Samsung revealed about the brand-new Galaxy Tab S12+ and what it has in store for future users.
The Galaxy Tab S12+ looks almost the same as the Tab S11, except it's larger and thinner (5.3mm from 5.5mm). However, it brings a couple of notable hardware upgrades, particularly in terms of display, speakers, and performance.
The Tab S12+ and Tab S12 Ultra are Samsung's first premium tablets to benefit from 4-channel spatial audio. Previous models had four speakers but only two channels. This new audio upgrade should elevate the experience with better surround sound, especially when watching movies and playing games.
Also worth noting is that the Galaxy Tab S12 is the first Android tablet to come pre-loaded with Adobe Photoshop.
Other productivity apps available on the Tab S12 by default include Notability, Goodnotes, LumaFusion, Notion, Clip Studio Paint, MyScript Math, MyScript Notes, Noteshelf, and ArcSite.
This year, Samsung is bringing the Pro Keyboard accessory to a non-Ultra Tab model. The aluminum-clad Pro Keyboard debuted last year exclusively for the larger Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra. Now, it will be available for both the Tab S12 Ultra and the smaller Tab S12+.
Samsung will also offer a cheaper Book Cover Keyboard Slim, as well as accessories such as a Book Cover and an anti-reflective screen protector.
All of these accessories, from the Pro Keyboard to screen protectors, will be sold separately. The S Pen is included for free.
The Galaxy Tab S12+ will go on sale in select markets starting October 7. You'll be able to order one in Gray and Silver for $1,199/€1,329/£1,199 (256GB model prices).

source_texts.title: Samsung reveals ultrathin Galaxy Tab S12 series and nearly a full day of battery life
source_texts.summary: We were expecting the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Tab S12+ to show up in September and they did; they just waited until the very last day.
source_texts.text:
We were expecting the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Tab S12+ to show up in September and they did; they just waited until the very last day.
At least now we know everything about the Galaxy Tab 12 series.
An ultrathin design with impressive battery life
The Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is Samsung’s thinnest Galaxy Tab, at 5.1mm and the Galaxy Tab S12+ is a hair more, at 5.3 mm.
They both offer plenty of screen space with a 2X Dynamic AMOLED display and brightness up to 1,600 nits. The Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra has a 14.6-inch display with 2960 x 1848 resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate, and the Galaxy Tab S12+ makes the most of its 12.6-inch display with a slim bezel and has 2800 x 1752 resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate.
Both tablets have the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 processor.
The battery life goes to nearly a full day, with the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra getting 23 hours on a single charge and the Galaxy Tab S12+ getting 21 hours. Both support 45W charging and can go from 0% to 100% in 95 minutes.
While a charger is not included with either tablet, both of them do come with an S Pen. There are four additional accessories made for, but not included with the tablets: a pro keyboard, book cover keyboard slim, book cover, and anti-reflecting screen protector.
A 3D Vapor Chamber handles heat dissipation for the tasks the tablets take on, like making the most of AI or editing videos.
As for cameras, the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra has a 12MP ultrawide front camera and rear 13MP and 8MP ultrawide cameras. The Galaxy Tab S12 has a front 12MP ultrawide front camera and 13MP rear camera.
Available next week
The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Tab S12+ will be on sale starting Oct. 7. They each come in gray and silver.
The Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra starts at $1,399.99. It comes with 12GB of RAM and 256GB to 512GB of storage, or 16GB RAM and 1TB of storage. You can expand storage up to 2TB with a microSD card.
The Galaxy Tab S12+ starts at $1,199.99. It comes with 12GB of RAM and 256GB to 512GB of storage, which is expandable to 2TB with a microSD card.
They come pre-loaded with Adobe Photoshop (and four months of free access to the Photoshop mobile plan), Notability (including a six-month subscription), and Goodnotes (one year of full access). There’s also a 66% discount on LumaFusion with one month of Creator Pass and a six-month trial of Google AI Pro.
Samsung has promised up to seven generations of OS upgrades and seven years of security updates for the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Tab S12+.

source_texts.title: I like the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra tablets, but you can get a Googlebook for less
source_texts.summary: For the Galaxy Tab S12 range, Samsung has brought back the Plus model, which joins a new iteration of its largest model, the Ultra.
source_texts.text:
For the Galaxy Tab S12 range, Samsung has brought back the Plus model, which joins a new iteration of its largest model, the Ultra.
Meet the Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, and prepare to be shocked by how much these big tablets cost.
Two new Tab tablets
The Plus is the new option
Samsung’s Galaxy Tab range has always been fragmented, and nothing has changed for 2026. Samsung has not launched a standard S12 model yet, and unlike the Galaxy Tab S10 series, it didn’t bother with a Plus, Lite, or an FE version of the S11 at all, so who knows how the S12 range will expand over time.
So far, Samsung has given you the choice of a big, expensive tablet or a massive, expensive tablet. Sure, these are high quality, high-spec models, but you’ll spend laptop money to get one.
The Galaxy Tab S12 Plus is an upgrade over the S10 Plus. It has a 12.6-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X Plus screen with a 120Hz refresh rate and 1,600 nit peak brightness, a 10,600mAh battery, and a new MediaTek Dimensity 9500 processor.
Handling the tablet, it feels lighter than the 553 gram weight suggests, and the 5.3mm thickness means it’s easy to grip and hold, but does feel a little sharp with its angled edges. The IP68 dust and water resistance rating makes it durable.
Software wins
Adobe Photoshop exclusive
It’s great to see Android 16 and One UI 9 on both the Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra complete with all the same features the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra comes with, including Gemini Intelligence, Now Brief, and Now Nudge.
Samsung’s pushing the Tab S12 models towards creative types, and has secured the Android release of Adobe Photoshop as an exclusive for six months. It comes with four months free access, and has been optimized for the S Pen stylus.
The good news is, there’s an S Pen stylus in the box, but you’ll have to pay extra for a keyboard. There are two options, the Book Cover Keyboard Slim and the Pro Keyboard. Both have hard keyboard bases so they can be used on your lap, but the Pro version comes with a clever hinge and a big trackpad, turning the tablet into a Galaxy Book-style machine.
I like the Pro Keyboard’s keys and motion, and how substantial the whole thing feels compared to the Book Cover Slim. However, it’s not light, and you’ll need a bag to carry it around. Samsung’s DeX system is available using a cable or wirelessly on both tablets.
What about the Ultra?
Still massive, still expensive
If the Galaxy Tab S12 Plus is the most obviously upgraded version, what about the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra?
It has a 14.6-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2x screen with the same spec as the Plus, along with the same processor, but a larger 11,600mAh battery. The same software as the Plus is onboard too, with the same keyboard options.
Eagle-eyed Galaxy Tab fans will recognize little has changed over the Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra, with the 5.1mm thickness and 692 gram weight being identical too.
It’s still a beautiful tablet though, and I love the slim bezels around the screen. It’s very impressive to see, and if you want to watch video on your tablet, it’s hard to find a better one than the Galaxy Tab Ultra models.
Don’t look for any design changes either, as put the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra next to the Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra, and they look absolutely identical.
How much do the Galaxy Tab S12 tablets cost?
More than the last models
Now we get to the difficult part. Both the Samsung Galaxy S12 Plus and Galaxy S12 Ultra are very expensive tablets.
The Galaxy Tab S12 Plus starts at $1,199 or £1,199, while the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra starts at $1,399 or £1,399. This gets you 256GB of storage space and the choice of grey or silver colors.
When you factor in neither comes with a keyboard case, and you’ll have to add around $400 to get the Pro Keyboard, you’re far beyond the price of a standard laptop.
Google’s newly announced Googlebook laptops start at $999, which is already expensive, but a comparative bargain next to the keyboard-less Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and Ultra.
Is it worth looking at a new Galaxy Tab S12 Plus or Ultra?
Yes, but don't ignore the alternatives
There are good things about the Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. They’re well-designed, well-made, and high-spec tablets with great software.
This is also true of the Galaxy Tab S11 series, and also true of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, which I think should also be considered if you’re planning to spend $1,800 on the S12 Ultra and a keyboard case. It may work out to be more versatile.
If you’re set on a tablet, then it’s hard not to recommend looking at either the Apple iPad Air, which starts at $750, or the iPad Pro 11-inch too, which starts at the same price as the new Galaxy Tab S12 Plus tablet.
However, it’s difficult to look at a very simple spec refresh paired with a $100 price increase favorably, particularly if you own one of the previous models. Both the Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and Galaxy S12 Ultra will be released on October 7.
Our review of the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra tablet will be out soon.
